blocks.body:
A heartfelt television campaign for the National Bank of Iraq, exploring the everyday ways parents care for their children and the importance of preparing for their future.

The film connects familiar family moments with a larger message about financial planning, using warmth, emotion, and relatable storytelling.

blocks.title: National Bank of Iraq Kids Account campaign film

blocks.body: Directed by Rafat Mhalla and Mohammad Jalal · 1 min 10 sec

The campaign builds its narrative around a simple emotional insight: caring for a child means thinking beyond the present.

Through recognizable family situations, the film draws a connection between the care parents provide every day and the decisions they make to support their children's future.

The creative direction prioritizes authentic moments, natural performances, and a warm visual atmosphere, allowing the message to develop through the story.

As Creative Director at Vision House, I collaborated with Mohammad Jalal on the campaign's creative development, shaping its emotional direction and visual storytelling from concept through production.
